# nemo Provider

Deploys stacks of bundles with [nemo](https://github.com/sntns/nemo): each `nemo_stack` is a manifest nemo reads, deployed on the Docker of its target with Swarm or Compose. The provider keeps the records of a stack's installations on its target, where `nemo status` and `nemo logs` find them from any machine that imported the stack's `manifest`, and marks the stack as Terraform's: nemo writes it only with `--force`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nemo = {
      source = "sntns/nemo"
    }
  }
}

provider "nemo" {}
```
